audience: Equipment buyers and traders comparing manufacturing and shipment declarations
intent: Define country of dispatch and distinguish manufacture, customs origin and seller location

baseline.segment: India accounts for 68 of 85 main-query impressions (56 desktop,12 mobile). Definitions are broad informational demand; commercial intent unconfirmed.
baseline.limits: Visible queries only, not total site/page traffic. No causal inference from low CTR. No GA4 link or verified enquiries.

overlap: Update current canonical article. Related EXW/FCA, DAP/DDP and export-packing articles serve different procurement decisions. Original publication date and slug retained.
change: Definition first; four-field comparison table; labelled Italy/UAE/Turkey quotation example; jurisdiction-specific transit caveat; query-aligned title/summary/meta description; dateModified only updated.

sources.use: Origin distinct from provenance; country-of-origin evidence depends on applicable rules.
UK DE5/14 distinguishes transit from defined intermediate events; not generalized worldwide.

serpReview: Search results mixed short definitions, dictionaries and customs manuals. Existing article opened with a scenario before defining dispatch. Reviewed primary WCO/UK guidance rather than copying dictionary wording; Google localized top-three positions not verified.
internalLinks: Preserved EXW/FCA, DAP/DDP, export packing and freight/expediting service destination.
cta: Enquiries remain routed to Oillinko for manual sourcing.

measurement.review: Compare equal 28-day windows by query/page/country/device after data settles; no schedule created.
measurement.hypothesis: Earlier definition and clearer comparisons improve relevance and snippet fit; increased rankings/clicks not guaranteed.
